scope: Risk-triggered Single independent review bound to a workspace source snapshot
changes: Added a separate read-only review request for high-risk source changes after host static validation succeeds.
The reviewer receives exact host-read source bytes, per-file SHA-256 values, the original user request, and frozen requirement quotes; approval must cite every reviewed source path.
Host records a ValidationReceipt and rechecks all snapshot hashes after the request; stale, malformed, rejected, unreadable, oversized, or sensitive-credential snapshots cannot be accepted.
Failed review returns structured evidence to the same Agent repair loop and reopens the accepted execution receipts until a later review passes.
Review model requests are included in current-turn usage and request telemetry; review uses the configured model route and is not model-diverse review.
